        let
            ExcelData = Excel.Workbook([Content], true),
            TableNames = ExcelData[Name],
            MatchingTables = List.Intersect({TableNames, TargetTables})
        in
            if List.Count(MatchingTables) = List.Count(TargetTables) then null else "Missing Tables"
    )

    AddCustom2;
